response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s AS (SELECT ordersmark, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.ordersmark AS order_reference, s.cnt AS execution_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, a ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
